Cloud database connection

Connect this LDK website to your own Supabase project to share records across devices.

Cloud database is not configured. Your current records remain on this computer until you configure and sign in below.

Use the SQL setup file supplied with this HTML in your Supabase SQL Editor first. Create a cloud account, sign in, then choose whether to upload local records or load cloud records. Never enter a service_role key here.

Local data management

Your browser keeps a local copy; the cloud database syncs records across devices after setup.

Export a backup before changing devices, clearing browser data, or resetting this system. Cloud synchronization requires internet access, a configured Supabase project, and a signed-in cloud account.
